FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.description: Have questions about our web page development services? We've got answers.

FAQcard.title: How long does it take to build a website?
FAQcard.description: A simple single-page or landing page typically takes 1–2 weeks. A full multi-page business website takes 3–6 weeks depending on content, design complexity, and revision rounds.

FAQcard.title: Do you build mobile-responsive websites?
FAQcard.description: Yes, every website we build is fully responsive and optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. Mobile-first design is our standard approach across all projects.

FAQcard.title: What technologies do you use?
FAQcard.description: We build with modern technologies including React, Next.js, WordPress, and plain HTML/CSS/JS. We recommend the best stack based on your project's specific needs and budget.

FAQcard.title: Will my website be SEO-friendly?
FAQcard.description: Absolutely. We follow SEO best practices in our development process — proper HTML structure, fast load times, meta tags, clean URLs, and schema markup are all standard.

FAQcard.title: Do you provide ongoing website maintenance?
FAQcard.description: Yes, we offer maintenance and support packages to keep your website updated, secure, and performing at its best long after launch.
